verdict.rationale: Cubic is an AI code-review service that processes customer code with AI models, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-retention policy, model-training use of code or prompts, or any opt-out control. Connecting a ChatGPT or Claude subscription for local reviews (cubic-docs-14) is about model choice, an adjacent feature, and does not count as a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
